ViewFilterChanged.description:
A saved Linear view whose filter changed since the previous poll. The issues the change brought
in or took out publish no `linear.issue.entered` or `linear.issue.left` and request no task.

baseline.description: True when the event came from the first poll of its stream.

entered.description: The identifiers of the issues now in the view that were not in it at the previous poll.

left.description: The identifiers of the issues in the view at the previous poll that are not in it now.

triggers.description: The triggers the event matched, so the triggers it requests tasks for; may be empty.

view.description: The view, as the trigger names it.

description:
A saved Linear view whose filter changed since the previous poll. The issues the change brought
in or took out publish no `linear.issue.entered` or `linear.issue.left` and request no task.

id.description: A UUIDv5 of the message's name, so a retried publish keeps its id.

links.description: GitHub and Linear events carry one link to the event's page.

subject.description: A short line for listings, such as `owner/name#42`.

title: linear.view.changed
